title: Retraction onto the n-skeleton away from the dual skeleton, Lipschitz with constant c/r off the r-tube (Simon 6.5.4, corrected)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ with m + 1 < P. There is c > 0 such that for every a ∈ ℝ^P (Euclid P) with |a_i − 1/2| < 1/4 for all i there is a map ψ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with the following properties, where L*(a) := {w : there is a finset s of coordinate indices with |s| ≥ m + 2 and w_i − a_i ∈ ℤ for all i ∈ s} (Simon's L_{ℓ−1}(a), ℓ = P − m − 1) and d(x) := infDist x L*(a): (i) for every x with d(x) > 0, ψ(x) lies in the (m+1)-skeleton of the unit cubical grid (there is a finset s with P ≤ m + 1 + |s| and ψ(x)_i ∈ ℤ for i ∈ s) and |ψ(x) − x| ≤ √P; (ii) for every r with 0 < r ≤ 1/4 and all x, y with d(x) ≥ r and d(y) ≥ r, |ψ(x) − ψ(y)| ≤ (c/r)|x − y|. The constant c depends only on P and m (not on a). This is Simon's Lemma 5.4 with the derivative bound (3) in Lipschitz form.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 1 < P → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ a : Euclid P, (∀ i, |a i - 1 / 2| < 1 / 4) → ∃ ψ : Euclid P → Euclid P, (∀ x : Euclid P, 0 < infDist x {w : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), m + 2 ≤ s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, w i - a i = z} → (∃ s : Finset (Fin P), P ≤ m + 1 + s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, ψ x i = z) ∧ dist (ψ x) x ≤ Real.sqrt P) ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 1 / 4 → ∀ x y : Euclid P, r ≤ infDist x {w : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), m + 2 ≤ s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, w i - a i = z} → r ≤ infDist y {w : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), m + 2 ≤ s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, w i - a i = z} → dist (ψ x) (ψ y) ≤ c / r * dist x y
